preconditions.description: The number of servers n is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between 0 and the minimum of n(n-1)/2 and 500,000.
The parameter k is between 0 and 60 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= c <= (1 << k) - 1 for c in c_list)
preconditions.description: Each encryption key c_i is in the range [0, 2^k - 1].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct servers with valid indices.
The number of provided edges matches m.

preconditions.expression: all(c_list[u-1] != c_list[v-1] for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: The initial assignment guarantees all connected servers have distinct keys.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer modulo 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: output_value == (sum(1 for x in range(1 << k) for subset_mask in range(1 << n) if all(c_list[u-1] ^ (x if (subset_mask >> (u-1)) & 1 else 0) != c_list[v-1] ^ (x if (subset_mask >> (v-1)) & 1 else 0) for u, v in edges)) % 1000000007
postconditions.description: The output equals the count of pairs (A, x) where A is a subset of servers and x is in [0, 2^k-1], such that for every edge (u, v), the modified keys of u and v are distinct. The modification applies x via XOR to servers in A.
